description: Junior reviewer finds basic error handling gap but misses a race condition in concurrent update. Accepts minimal fix.

prContext.title: Add candidate status update endpoint

groundTruth.description: No validation on status field — accepts any string including SQL injection attempts (though parameterized, invalid status values corrupt data integrity).
Read-then-write race condition: two concurrent requests can read the same stage_id, then both overwrite, losing one update and any audit trail of the intermediate state.
Success response returns no updated row data — client must refetch.

reviewer_comments.what: Should validate status against allowed values.
reviewer_comments.why: Could update with invalid status string.

reviewer_comments.what: Prefer early return style with guard clause.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Add status validation. Optional style fix.

implementer_responses.updated_code: const ALLOWED = ['new', 'screening', 'interview', 'offer']; if (!ALLOWED.includes(status)) return c.json({ error: 'invalid_status' }, 400);

implementer_responses.content: I find the current style readable enough.

verdict.summary: Validation looks good. Style is fine as-is.
